message: The check character is 'A' but the first 14 characters give 'B'. One or more characters are probably mistyped.
suggested_fix: Re-enter the whole GSTIN from the source document. Do not just change the last character: the mistake is usually somewhere in the first 14.

message: IGST is charged but the supply is intra-state (supplier state 27 Maharashtra, place of supply 27 Maharashtra).
suggested_fix: Charge CGST + SGST in equal halves, or correct the place of supply. SEZ and export supplies are not modelled by this tool.

message: Tax charged is 170.00 but 1000.00 x 18% is 180.00 (difference 10.00, tolerance 0.01).
suggested_fix: Recalculate the tax, or correct the rate or taxable value. If your invoices round tax differently, raise tolerance.tax_amount in the config.

message: The GSTIN has lower-case letters or surrounding spaces. It was checked as '27PQRXS5678T1ZB'.
suggested_fix: Store GSTINs in upper case with no spaces.

message: Taxable value is 1000.00 but 3 x 500.00 is 1500.00.
suggested_fix: Check quantity, unit price and taxable value. If the difference is a discount, this warning can be ignored or MATH-003 disabled in the config.
Check the year and whether day and month are swapped.

message: The HSN/SAC code '84A1' contains something other than digits.
suggested_fix: Enter the code as digits only, with no spaces, dots or letters.

message: The invoice number contains characters that are not allowed: '=', '+'.
suggested_fix: Use only letters, digits, '/' and '-' in invoice numbers.

message: IGST is charged but the supply is intra-state (supplier state 04 Chandigarh, place of supply 04 Chandigarh).
suggested_fix: Charge CGST + UTGST in equal halves (enter UTGST in the sgst column), or correct the place of supply. SEZ and export supplies are not modelled by this tool.
